title: Reinforcement Learning from Real-Robot Interaction without High-Quality State Estimates
abstract: arXiv:2610.14042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A longstanding goal for robot reinforcement learning (RL) is that robots learn from their own physical experience, as humans and animals do. A key obstacle to learning directly from physical experience, especially outside instrumented lab environments, is that the state of the world is usually unobservable to the learner and must be estimated from on-board sensing. Errors in that estimate corrupt both the policy input and potentially the reward signal. We study this challenge using the contact-rich task of a bipedal robot learning to score soccer goals. We estimate all key state variables on-board with an unscented Kalman filter (UKF) and no external instrumentation (e.g., motion capture or overhead cameras). Because the UKF may incorrectly estimate state when the ball is unobserved, we learn a new state representation with a recurrent state-space model (RSSM) that, critically, only corrects the RSSM's latent state when the ball is obs

translated_title: 无需高质量状态估计的真实机器人交互强化学习
translated_abstract: 机器人强化学习（RL）的一个长期目标是让机器人像人类和动物一样，从自身的物理经验中学习。直接从物理经验中学习的一个关键障碍，尤其是在缺乏仪器设备的实验室环境之外，在于世界的状态通常对学习者是不可观测的，必须通过机载传感器进行估计。估计误差会破坏策略输入，并可能破坏奖励信号。我们通过双足机器人学习踢足球射门的接触密集型任务来研究这一挑战。我们使用无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF）在机载估计所有关键状态变量，且不依赖任何外部测量设备（如动作捕捉系统或顶置摄像头）。由于UKF在球未被观测到时可能产生错误的状态估计，我们通过循环状态空间模型（RSSM）学习一种新的状态表示，其关键在于，只有当球被观测到时才对RSSM的潜在状态进行修正。
tldr: 提出结合UKF与仅在被观测时修正潜在状态的RSSM状态表示，使双足机器人在无任何外部测量设备、仅有不完美机载状态估计的条件下，通过真实物理交互学会足球射门。
en_tdlr: Proposes a state representation combining a UKF with an RSSM that only corrects its latent state when the ball is observed, enabling a bipedal robot to learn soccer goal scoring through real-robot interaction without external instrumentation or high-quality state estimates.
